description: This file implements the TlsServerConnectionMiddleware class that manages TLS handshake and secure connection establishment for server connections within the Orleans framework. It includes certificate handling, SSL stream configuration, and connection feature setup.

classes.name: TlsServerConnectionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that handles TLS server-side connection establishment, including certificate selection, SSL stream authentication, and feature setting.

methods.name: OnConnectionAsync
methods.description: Initiates processing of a new connection, managing TLS handshake asynchronously.

methods.name: InnerOnConnectionAsync
methods.description: Performs the core TLS handshake and connection setup asynchronously, including certificate validation and feature configuration.

methods.name: EnsureCertificateIsAllowedForServerAuth
methods.description: Validates that the provided server certificate is allowed for server authentication.

methods.name: ConvertToX509Certificate2
methods.description: Converts a generic X509Certificate to an X509Certificate2 object if necessary.
